name: Montage Palmetto Bluff
positioning: Lowcountry resort on the May River in South Carolina, between Hilton Head Island and Savannah, centered on an inn modeled after a historic mansion
best_for: Families who want a kids' club and outdoor river activities
Travelers who want nature, golf and a slow-paced Southern resort

facts.text: Montage Palmetto Bluff sits along the May River in South Carolina's Lowcountry, between Hilton Head Island and Savannah.
Three-quarters of Palmetto Bluff is a protected nature reserve.
The resort was formerly The Inn at Palmetto Bluff.
The resort is in the heart of Wilson Village, where the ruins of the Wilson mansion can still be seen.
Accommodations include cottages, guestrooms, suites and village homes that reflect the Lowcountry's heritage.
Some of the cottages face the May River.
Spa Montage draws on the Coastal Carolina environment for a nature-inspired wellness experience.
The property has an on-site bird conservatory and a Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course.
At the Inn, the Octagon Porch and Bar serve a Southern-inflected menu.
Buffalo's, by the main square in Wilson Village, serves a Biscuit Bar at breakfast.
R.T.'s, the general store, has a deli, wine and local souvenirs.

highlights.text: The River House hosts daily porching, with lemonade and cookies served on the screened-in porch.
The resort has canine ambassadors, dogs that roam the grounds.
The Inn is modeled after the historic mansion of Richard T. Wilson, a New York multimillionaire.
On-site outfitters arrange boating on the river, island visits, kayaking, tubing and paddleboarding.
Paintbox, the kids' club, has daily activities focused on the natural environment, wildlife and Lowcountry culture.

considerations.text: Alligators live in the area, so swimming in the river and lagoons is not advised.
Bike paths and golf carts are how guests get around the property.
WhataHotel notes the secluded Lowcountry location requires planned transportation.
